scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation
scenarios.description: Escalation of Middle East or Eastern European conflicts disrupting energy supplies and trade routes.

impacts.explanation: Supply chain disruptions and higher energy costs reduce economic output.
Higher oil prices and supply shocks drive up commodity costs.

scenarios.reasoning: High probability due to ongoing tensions in key regions, but uncertainty in timing and scale
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Energy Crisis
scenarios.description: Sudden global energy shortage due to extreme weather or geopolitical blockades.

impacts.explanation: Energy prices spike, increasing production and transport costs.
Construction costs rise, delaying new housing projects.

scenarios.reasoning: Moderate probability based on climate vulnerability and geopolitical fragility of energy infrastructure
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: AI-Driven Productivity Boom
scenarios.description: Rapid adoption of AI and automation boosts industrial efficiency and output.

impacts.explanation: Automation reduces costs and increases manufacturing capacity.
New tech jobs emerge in AI and robotics sectors.

scenarios.reasoning: High upside potential from tech trends, though adoption speed is uncertain
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work in each problem

scenarios.name: Federal Debt-Driven Inflation
scenarios.description: Rising government borrowing crowds out private investment and raises interest rates.

impacts.explanation: Monetary tightening reduces asset prices and investment.
Higher borrowing costs reduce consumer spending.

scenarios.reasoning: Strong probability given record debt levels and Fed's macroprudential stance
tetlockCommandments: Strive to distinguish as many degrees of doubt as the problem permits

scenarios.name: Trade War De-escalation
scenarios.description: Negotiated resolution of US-China or EU trade tensions improves global supply chains.

impacts.explanation: Lower military procurement needs decrease deficit growth.

scenarios.reasoning: Moderate upside from diplomatic momentum but dependent on political will
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Recession Triggered by Debt
scenarios.description: High debt servicing costs and reduced consumer confidence trigger a slowdown.

impacts.explanation: Fiscal austerity and higher interest rates reduce investment.
Labor market cools as industry and tech sectors contract.

scenarios.reasoning: Lower probability but high impact given structural debt vulnerabilities
tetlockCommandments: Bring out the best in others and let others bring out the best in you

methodology: Applied Tetlock's superforecasting principles: probabilistic thinking for scenario-based forecasting, outside view for baseline assumptions, and granular analysis to isolate driver factors. Probabilities derived from historical analogs and current signals.
geopoliticalSummary: Ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine pose risks to energy security and global trade stability.
geoeconomicSummary: Supply chain vulnerabilities persist despite recent improvements, with AI adoption creating new growth opportunities.
currentEventsSummary: Recent fiscal stimulus measures and AI investment trends are key domestic drivers, while Fed interest rate policies remain critical macro controls.
